questions.name: Performance rolling averages · completed history
questions.description: R016 Metabase query-builder helper. Existing calendar + model 74; calendar gaps preserved. Strict trailing seven calendar days, full completed history before display filters. Cumulative unavailable after a missing input. Do not add a date filter inside this helper. No new SQL or database objects.

questions.name: Daily gross interest & 7-day average
questions.description: Gross interest from completed daily snapshots; seven calendar days ending on each plotted day. Filter only this outer question. First six or missing-input windows have no average. Daily goal 10,000 baht. Not net profit.

questions.name: Cumulative gross interest · MA7
questions.description: Model 74 gross interest accumulated since available history began; never reset by the display filter. Blue line averages seven cumulative levels. Missing prior history makes cumulative unavailable. Completed dates only.

questions.name: Rolling-average coverage · selected completed dates
questions.description: Origin and counts of selected dates with complete seven-day inputs. History starts means available snapshot origin, not business inception. Earlier dates outside the selected period still contribute to averages. Original snapshot coverage panel retains generation times. Choose one continuous range.

visualization_settings.text: Selected-period results · live on report refresh
Weekly = principal ÷ loans. Partial weeks use selected days only.
End-of-day counts use loan/close dates; do not sum across dates.
Yesterday refreshes hourly; rebuild older corrections. MA7 needs 7 complete days, including before the filter. Cumulative starts at history origin. Use one continuous range.
